data.body: RCA confirmed (rebar-debug fast path): _apply_delta's checkout-index (src/rebar/_snapshot/delta_tree.py) ran through _store/gitutil.run_git, whose timeout defaults to None ('timeout (when set) lets TimeoutExpired propagate' — gitutil.py docstring), so the call was unbounded; the sibling read-tree two statements earlier goes through git_fetch.git_run which applies _GIT_TIMEOUT=300 (git_fetch.py) and folds a timeout into a returncode-124 CompletedProcess. git_run cannot carry stdin (no input_data param) which is why the site bypassed it. Fix (per ticket scope, git_run and _GIT_TIMEOUT untouched): pass timeout=_GIT_TIMEOUT to the run_git call, catch subprocess.TimeoutExpired, log a warning naming git checkout-index, and return False so callers fall back to full materialization (fail-closed). RED->GREEN in tests/unit/test_delta_tree_timeout_b0e0.py: stalled fake-git checkout-index observed running unbounded 20.2s RED and TimeoutExpired escaping _apply_delta RED; after the fix the call is cut off at the bound, the diagnostic names the operation, the fallback produces the faithful tree, and _GIT_TIMEOUT is pinned at 300. lint/typecheck/complexity ratchet pass.
